description: Fetch one public AgendaForge page as markdown by its exact route (such as /pricing), canonical URL, or markdown URL. Use it after search_docs to read a result in full; only pages in the public docs index can be fetched. Returns the page title, canonical url, and markdown body (up to 200 KB).

route.description: Exact route, canonical URL, or markdown URL present in the public docs index.

name: fetch_doc
